character.name: Ling
character.obligationNotes: Oath · Loyalty (10). He does not betray those who have earned his loyalty through respect, reliability and rapport.

talents.name: Quick Draw
talents.notes: Once per round on his turn, ready or holster one accessible weapon as an incidental. A second pistol still takes a maneuver.

talents.name: Quick Strike
talents.notes: Add one Boost to combat checks against a target that has not yet acted in this encounter. Not a bonus that resets every round.

inventory.name: Patched charcoal suit, shirt, tie and leather boots
inventory.notes: Patched charcoal suit, pale shirt, loose dark tie and scuffed leather boots. Ordinary clothing; no armour bonus.

inventory.name: Paired shoulder holsters
inventory.notes: Two shoulder holsters. No special draw bonus.

inventory.name: Pocket repair tools
inventory.notes: Screwdriver, adjustable wrench, duct tape and cloth for simple maintenance.

character.motivation: Money and comfort, independence, and the thrill of danger. Loyalty is earned through respect, reliability and rapport.
character.notes: Born in Denver. Surviving on his own since leaving his gang. A few weeks on the Baja border; no local contracts taken yet.

session.checkpoint: Alone on the NCR–Baja border, nearly broke. The first job is still ahead.

journal.title: Born into the gang
journal.body:
Mao Ling, usually called Ling, grew up on Denver’s poor streets in a small bandit gang beneath the Hangdogs. His ancestors were Triad members, but little of the old organization survived beyond its influence on the gang’s culture. His parents died when he was young. He became one of its young guns.

As Lanius’s conquests approached, he tried to warn the others. When they would not listen, he slipped away alone. Since then he has been surviving, not building a reputation.

journal.title: Nearly broke in Baja
journal.body: Ling has spent a few weeks along the NCR–Baja border. He knows the general lay of the land but has taken no local jobs. Drinking, gambling and brothels have consumed most of his last payday. He has two battered pipe pistols, a patched suit and twenty caps left. He starts alone.
